get.description: Lists the private-network workers bound to the environment. Any member with secrets:read can see names, targets and last-seen times; tokens and certificates are never returned.

post.description: Creates a worker bound to this environment and the postgres target and returns a single-use ten-minute enrollment token. Admin-only; audited as worker.create.

200.description: Worker created with a one-time enrollment token

delete.description: Deletes a worker and its queued jobs and enrollments. Admin in the worker's workspace; audited as worker.delete.

post.description: Public enrollment: exchanges a one-time enrollment token and an OpenSSH ed25519 public key for a ten-minute certificate whose only principal is worker:<id>, pinned with force-command none and loopback source-address. Single use; audited enrollment updates last the worker row.

200.description: Certificate and instance CA public key

401.description: Unknown, spent or expired enrollment token

post.description: Renews the caller's certificate. Requires a current certificate in the x-openwarp-cert header signed by the instance CA naming the worker.

Claims the oldest queued job for the authenticated worker. Payloads are encrypted to the environment key; claims older than sixty seconds return to the queue and the conditional update lets only one caller take a job.

200.description: Job or null job field when the queue is empty

post.description: Finishes a claimed job with an encrypted outcome. Only the worker that claimed it; the update repeats the claimed guard.

400.description: Job not claimed by this worker
